readback: For every coffee item on a transaction (a line item whose product category is Coffee), the member gets 5 DELTA MILES per unit bought. For example, 3 coffees earn 15 points.
assumptions: 'Coffee item' is taken to mean the product category COFFEE (Coffee) only. Cappuccino (CPCN) and Latte are separate categories and are not included unless you add them.
Points are given per unit bought (line-item quantity), so buying 2 of the same coffee earns 10 points.
No activity type was given, so the offer applies to any transaction that has coffee line items.
No start date, end date, usage limit or cap was given, so the offer has none.
